title: Gnumu Business
description: Formal contact with the settlement is one thing; understanding what its merchants actually value is another. Trade with a Gnumu Merchant using their own Doubloons, then return to the principal settlement's trader.
description_completed: The Overlord has completed a native Gnumu trade using the settlement's own currency and seen its local commerce firsthand.

dialogue.offer: The Elder may judge rulers. I judge customers. Bring Doubloons to a Gnumu Merchant and make a proper trade. Then we can discuss whether the dark tower understands business.
dialogue.in_progress: No trade yet? Titles are impressive, but Doubloons are easier to count.
dialogue.ready_to_turn_in: Good. You used our money and completed a proper bargain. That is a language merchants understand.
dialogue.completed: If you have Doubloons, there will usually be a Gnumu willing to discuss where they should go.

prerequisites.name: Establish formal contact with the principal Gnumu settlement

objectives.name: Trade with a Gnumu Merchant using Gnumus Doubloons
